terminal_revenue_low_usd.label: terminal revenue low usd
terminal_revenue_low_usd.note: 360iResearch 2024 container-terminal-operator market estimate, verified on GII's full reseller listing dated28Aug2025; not stated on the current publisher page. Commercial estimate, not audited global receipts.

terminal_revenue_mid_usd.label: terminal revenue mid usd
terminal_revenue_mid_usd.note: TechSci 2024 container-terminal operations estimate, directly verified on its June2025 release. Scope includes storage/intermodal services and cargo categories broader than containers; not audited global receipts or an interpolated midpoint.

terminal_revenue_high_usd.label: terminal revenue high usd
terminal_revenue_high_usd.note: Upper verified benchmark repeats TechSci2024 estimate. Unverified IBISWorld figure excluded, not carried as an assumed upper bound. This is a commercial-estimate comparison range, not three independent market measurements.

global.input_summary: inputs: 920M TEU, 520k calls, assumed 10 % restows at $75 a lift, 5 % less berth time

what_must_be_true: Full-ship, multi-port planning works; these rates hold worldwide; the extra work is avoidable; operational use needs terms that permit it: today's Muse Glimmer usage policy prohibits use related to operating transportation technologies where harm is possible; a deployment would need Meta's permission or a base model whose terms allow it, plus class approval; none of it has been measured.
Earlier departure must free usable vessel time.
Box mix, one container per lift, fleet-weighted time, rates, wages and adoption need validation.
Costs of compute, integration and support must be deducted in a business case; the engine is not competitive at large scale yet.
who_for: Potential leads: feeder operators and planning teams at Laem Chabang and Bangkok; no partnership or outreach implied.
limits: This is a gross opportunity scenario, not an audited global loss, net savings, software revenue or a result achieved. No operational saving is measured.
